title: Progressive Dinner Byward
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Best Restaurants of the ByWard!
Let our guide take you on a dining adventure to some of the best restaurants of Ottawa’s most historic and visited neighbourhood – the ByWard Market!

This ‘restaurant crawl’ experience includes the following:

A 3- or 4-course, BLIND-tasting (Chef’s choice) meal including carefully paired drinks by expert mixologists and sommeliers  

An expert C’est Bon guide who will share stories and information about the restaurant, chefs and owners, the neighborhood and food culture of the city!

Interaction with the restaurant staff, owners and/or chefs

ITINERARY:
Meet your guide – A specified meeting point will be shared with you. If you are staying at a hotel within walking distance, we will meet you there!

Restaurant #1: Appetizer course plus cocktail

Restaurant #2: Main course plus wine

Restaurant #3: Dessert course plus apperitif
